findings.detail: The long says the complaint’s final disposition is unstated, lists the records needed for a “final account,” and repeats that no finding of guilt is shown. Those source-gaps instructions and repeated disclaimers crowd out details of the filing and its allegations.

The long description is null. The medium reports Sherwin’s statement about evidentiary standards and alleges Barr interfered, while noting that no letter or charging file confirms his role; it has no expanded account of the dispute.

The long states that the $25,000 payment to Bondi was a bribe to drop the Trump University investigation and asserts systematic fraud, illegal donations, and misuse across multiple purposes. The medium limits the account to a payment while the office was considering an investigation and a $2 million court-ordered payment for misuse; it does not establish the asserted quid pro quo or every sweeping charge in the long.

The first paragraph of the long reproduces the medium almost word-for-word. The remaining material adds the special counsel’s scope and removal rules, but then repeats the same disclaimer about what the appointment did not prove.
The last two sentences make the same point twice: the appointment did not establish fabrication or crimes, and it authorized examination of those issues.
